asked QD1-001: D1a: the close-check fails on a defect between two tools, not on my outputs. handoff.py copies each element's dimension into VOCABULARY.json as the frozen model/elements.jsonl holds it, a list (28 one-item lists, 1 two-item, 1 empty; every listed id is in dimensions.jsonl). tools/checks/stage_D1.py line 217 reads the field as one value (vlib.DIM.match(str(['D01']))), so it gives 30 errors, shape vocab:dim. Stage C2's check (stage_C2.py line 236) accepts the list, and validate.py C5 passed on the same ledger. I cannot fix it from out/: editing the model would change the frozen hash, handoff.py will not rebuild the folder, and the folder is hashed (61b03bbf...). May the check be changed to accept a list of dimension ids, as stage C2's check does, or should the vocabulary be rebuilt with a scalar dimension? | meanwhile: I change no model file, no tool and nothing in handoff-D/. I finish D1a (notes-D1.md section 3, the checks, handback-D1.md, the head) and run done.sh D1 --cut packets-out. If the close-check fails only on these 30 vocab:dim errors, the leg stays open and I stop; the next packet carries the answer.

R1 read carried elements from the order tests' theme file (_analysis/c2_elements_c5c2.json), which has no line for C02. That is my omission, not a rule; E1 should read C02 as unpredicted. A12 (P01 to P15, thin, theorised) is expected nowhere because P15 is never carried by a placement; P15 itself is expected by R2. The tentative entries and the candidates are expected nowhere by rule. (2) Expectation 13 (the residue clause in why) reaches the four colour-faction story-miss rooms but none of the four host rooms (catalunya, placeDE, smashbros, sweden): their themes are not on P19's host themes, the proxy R5 used. catalunya's line expects C01 absent.
